catalogInput.label: Gothic II Gold / Night of the Raven folder
catalogInput.note: Drop your installed game folder containing Data and System.

inputs.evidence: The Quest installer prepares purchased Gothic II Gold/Night of the Raven data; the source root contains Data and System.

catalogInput.label: Carmageddon game folder
catalogInput.note: Prepare the original files listed in the author’s files_needed.txt.

inputs.evidence: The Quest data path is the app files directory; the author points to files_needed.txt for the exact copied subset.

catalogInput.label: Super Mario Galaxy disc image
catalogInput.note: Drop your owned Wii ISO, RVZ, WBFS, GCZ, WIA or CISO disc image.

inputs.evidence: The author installer explicitly offers ISO, RVZ, WBFS, or an already extracted disc folder; it cooks data before headset transfer. GCZ, WIA, and CISO are not listed as accepted installer inputs.
inputs.proposedCopyText: Select your owned Super Mario Galaxy ISO, RVZ or WBFS image, or an already extracted game folder. The creator installer converts and copies cooked data; do not copy the raw image to the app game folder.

catalogInput.label: Animal Crossing USA Rev 0 disc
catalogInput.note: Own GAFE01_00 USA Rev 0. The author installer checks the disc header and transfers it privately.

inputs.evidence: The current Quest package requires USA Rev 0 GAFE01_00 in ISO, GCM or CISO form; its installer validates and transfers the disc.

catalogInput.label: Mario Strikers Charged USA Rev 1 disc
catalogInput.note: Own USA R4QE01 revision 1; other revisions are not documented.

inputs.evidence: The author specifies USA R4QE01 revision 1 and ISO, RVZ, or WIA; other regions and revisions fail.

catalogInput.label: Owned GT2 Arcade or Simulation disc
catalogInput.note: Drop one owned US or European BIN or ISO disc image. For a CUE/BIN set, drop a ZIP containing both files so the references stay together.

inputs.evidence: The Quest installer requires a complete 2352-byte-sector BIN/CUE image. The author warns that ordinary 2048-byte ISO files omit required XA sectors.
inputs.proposedCopyText: Provide a complete owned GT2 Arcade or Simulation raw 2352-byte-sector BIN/CUE image from a supported revision. A plain 2048-byte ISO is not suitable. Select one image per disc; keep the CUE and referenced BIN together.

catalogInput.label: Extracted CUSA12392 game folder
catalogInput.note: Drop your own decrypted European CUSA12392 game tree containing eboot.bin, sce_sys and sce_module. Raw disc images and encrypted PS Store packages cannot be used.

inputs.evidence: The current author guide accepts European CUSA12392 v1.00/1.04 and American CUSA12431; the Quest needs a decrypted extracted game folder with eboot.bin, sce_sys, sce_module, including param.sfo.
inputs.proposedCopyText: Choose your decrypted extracted ASTRO BOT Rescue Mission folder: European CUSA12392 v1.00 or 1.04, or American CUSA12431 when its supported build is identified. Include eboot.bin, sce_sys/param.sfo and sce_module. Encrypted PS Store packages cannot be used directly.

catalogInput.label: Supported Pokémon Red, Blue or Yellow ROM
catalogInput.note: Use your own supported cartridge dump. Yellow support is still beta.

inputs.evidence: The launcher imports canonical US Red, Blue, Yellow and Gold ROMs. Red, Blue and Yellow are the current VR focus; Gold VR gameplay is unfinished.

catalogInput.label: Halo CE Xbox disc image
catalogInput.note: An owned Xbox Halo CE disc image; import it in the headset.

inputs.evidence: The Quest importer accepts an owned original-Xbox Halo CE ISO or XISO in any region and version.

catalogInput.label: Owned 18 Wheeler USA CHD
catalogInput.note: Use your own USA Dreamcast MK-51064 disc dump in CHD format.

inputs.evidence: The creator requires the USA MK-51064 Dreamcast disc as CHD or as GDI plus BIN tracks. The catalog requireOneOf expresses the alternatives.

catalogInput.label: Owned 18 Wheeler USA GDI folder
catalogInput.note: Choose the folder with the USA MK-51064 .gdi index and its .bin tracks; VR4ALL copies both. Leave out any .cue file.

inputs.evidence: The creator requires the USA MK-51064 Dreamcast disc as CHD or as GDI plus BIN tracks. The catalog requireOneOf expresses the alternatives.

catalogInput.label: Owned MAME confmiss.zip
catalogInput.note: The MAME set confmiss, with its key inside; it stays packed.

inputs.evidence: The creator requires confmiss.zip, matching disc, and NAOMI BIOS unless embedded in the game ZIP. The game can also recognize a complete CUE or GDI disc layout, though the VR4ALL recipe only exposes CHD.

catalogInput.label: Owned confmiss disc (gds-0001.chd)
catalogInput.note: The GD-ROM from the same MAME set.

inputs.evidence: The creator also accepts a complete matching .cue or .gdi disc set, while the catalog offers only CHD.
inputs.proposedCopyText: Provide the matching gds-0001.chd in Download/confmiss/ for VR4ALL. The port also supports complete matching CUE or GDI disc layouts with all tracks, which VR4ALL does not currently offer.

catalogInput.label: Optional NAOMI BIOS
catalogInput.note: naomi.zip, unless the BIOS is inside your confmiss.zip.

inputs.evidence: The creator requires confmiss.zip, matching disc, and NAOMI BIOS unless embedded in the game ZIP. The game can also recognize a complete CUE or GDI disc layout, though the VR4ALL recipe only exposes CHD.

catalogInput.label: Owned original MAME lupinshoo.zip
catalogInput.note: Original GDS-0018 set with 317-0325-jpn.pic inside. Keep it packed. Rev A (lupinsho) is not supported.

inputs.evidence: The original GDS-0018 lupinshoo ZIP and gds-0018 CHD are required; Rev A is unsupported. A supported BIOS may be embedded or supplied separately.

catalogInput.label: Owned original Lupin disc (gds-0018.chd)
catalogInput.note: Original GDS-0018 disc, not GDS-0018A. The Lupin start screen checks the CHD header revision.

inputs.evidence: The original GDS-0018 lupinshoo ZIP and gds-0018 CHD are required; Rev A is unsupported. A supported BIOS may be embedded or supplied separately.

catalogInput.label: Optional NAOMI BIOS
catalogInput.note: naomi.zip, unless a supported BIOS is already inside your game ZIP.

inputs.evidence: The original GDS-0018 lupinshoo ZIP and gds-0018 CHD are required; Rev A is unsupported. A supported BIOS may be embedded or supplied separately.

catalogInput.label: Owned World NJA2 Ver.A ninjaslt.zip
catalogInput.note: Complete World cartridge set with all 12 ROM entries. Keep it packed and lowercase. Regional ninjaslta, ninjasltj and ninjasltu clones are not supported.

inputs.evidence: World NJA2 Ver.A ninjaslt.zip needs all twelve cartridge entries; a supported NAOMI BIOS can be embedded or in naomi.zip.

catalogInput.label: Optional supported NAOMI BIOS
catalogInput.note: Provide naomi.zip unless a supported BIOS is inside your ninjaslt.zip.

inputs.evidence: World NJA2 Ver.A ninjaslt.zip needs all twelve cartridge entries; a supported NAOMI BIOS can be embedded or in naomi.zip.

catalogInput.label: Owned Japan Rev A deathcoxj.zip
catalogInput.note: Complete Japan Rev A cartridge: epr-23524a.ic22 (CRC b60e113e) and ten 8 MiB MPR ROMs. Keep it packed. An older merged deathcox.zip may contain Rev A; VR4ALL copies it separately as deathcoxj.zip. Current USA deathcox and original Japan deathcoxo are unsupported.

inputs.evidence: Japan Rev A deathcoxj with the listed EPR and ten MPR chips is required. A compatible BIOS may be embedded or supplied separately.

catalogInput.label: Optional supported NAOMI BIOS
catalogInput.note: Provide naomi.zip unless a supported BIOS is inside your game ZIP.

inputs.evidence: Japan Rev A deathcoxj with the listed EPR and ten MPR chips is required. A compatible BIOS may be embedded or supplied separately.

catalogInput.label: Owned World BHF2 Ver. E gunsur2.zip
catalogInput.note: Complete NAOMI World BHF2 Ver. E cartridge with all 15 ROMs. Keep it packed and lowercase. Japanese gunsur2j revisions are unsupported; renaming them does not convert the game.

inputs.evidence: The World gunsur2 cartridge needs 15 ROMs and a supported NAOMI BIOS embedded or separate; Japanese revisions are unsupported.

catalogInput.label: Optional supported NAOMI BIOS
catalogInput.note: Provide naomi.zip unless a supported BIOS is inside your gunsur2.zip.

inputs.evidence: The World gunsur2 cartridge needs 15 ROMs and a supported NAOMI BIOS embedded or separate; Japanese revisions are unsupported.

catalogInput.label: Owned CarnEvil v1.0.3 ROM ZIP
catalogInput.note: Keep the v1.0.3 ZIP packed. It must contain carnevil1_9.u32, sound102.u95 and 486_carnevil.u96.

inputs.evidence: The author requires v1.0.3 carnevil.zip and matching carnevil/carnevil.chd; no NAOMI BIOS.

catalogInput.label: Owned CarnEvil v1.0.3 CHD
catalogInput.note: Matching CarnEvil v1.0.3 CHDv5 disc. The port checks its disk identity and ROM hashes in the headset setup screen.

inputs.evidence: The author requires v1.0.3 carnevil.zip and matching carnevil/carnevil.chd; no NAOMI BIOS.

catalogInput.label: Prepared US UEL terabrst.zip
catalogInput.note: July 17, 1998 US UEL: all eleven ROM payloads. Use the preparation tool to normalize an owned archive; renaming a 7z file is insufficient. No CHD or separate BIOS is needed.

inputs.evidence: The supported US UEL July 17 1998 terabrst.zip must be complete; there is no CHD or separate BIOS.

catalogInput.label: Owned original Virtua Cop Revision B vcop.zip
catalogInput.note: Keep the original arcade set packed. A complete combined ZIP with the 26 game/board ROMs and both I/O/LCD firmware payloads is supported. This port uses its own Download/vcop-vr folder, preserving the existing Cop VR game files.

inputs.evidence: Revision B vcop requires 28 verified payloads. Separate model1io2 and possibly hd44780 archives can supply I/O and LCD firmware, or they may be combined in vcop.zip.

catalogInput.label: Optional separate model1io2.zip I/O and LCD firmware
catalogInput.note: Provide epr-17181.6 here unless it is already in vcop.zip. The LCD firmware can be in vcop.zip, model1io2.zip or the separate optional hd44780.zip.

inputs.evidence: Revision B vcop requires 28 verified payloads. Separate model1io2 and possibly hd44780 archives can supply I/O and LCD firmware, or they may be combined in vcop.zip.

catalogInput.label: Optional separate hd44780.zip LCD firmware
catalogInput.note: Supply hd44780_a00.bin here when it is absent from vcop.zip and model1io2.zip. Keep the firmware archive packed.

inputs.evidence: Revision B vcop requires 28 verified payloads. Separate model1io2 and possibly hd44780 archives can supply I/O and LCD firmware, or they may be combined in vcop.zip.

catalogInput.label: Owned original Virtua Cop 2 vcop2.zip
catalogInput.note: Original arcade Model 2A set with all 30 game, CPU-board and video-board ROMs. Keep it packed. A combined ZIP containing these and the billboard firmware is also supported.

inputs.evidence: The original Model 2A set needs all 31 payloads. segabill may be separate or combined into vcop2.zip.

catalogInput.label: Optional separate segabill.zip billboard firmware
catalogInput.note: Provide epr-18022.ic2 in segabill.zip unless it is already inside vcop2.zip. Setup requires all 31 actual ROM payloads across the supplied archives; optional means a separate ZIP is unnecessary for a complete combined set.

inputs.evidence: The original Model 2A set needs all 31 payloads. segabill may be separate or combined into vcop2.zip.

catalogInput.label: Owned Gran Turismo 3 A-Spec disc image
catalogInput.note: Use an ISO made from your own PlayStation 2 disc. Other formats are not supported by this port.

inputs.evidence: Only ISO images are read. NTSC-U SCUS-97102 and PBPX-95503 are verified; other regions are untested.

catalogInput.label: Owned Bloodlines Vampire folder
catalogInput.note: Choose the Vampire folder from an installed original Steam or GOG copy, or a ZIP/7z/RAR containing it. VR4ALL downloads the creator patch separately and combines them on the Quest.

inputs.evidence: The author requires the complete Vampire folder, with pack000.vpk directly inside, plus an Unofficial Patch pack and its credits/pack.json at /sdcard/vtmb.

catalogInput.label: Owned Gunblade NY arcade set
catalogInput.note: Complete original Model 2 gunblade set. The game checks every required ROM payload.

inputs.evidence: The catalog says original Model 2B but omits the creator-required Revision A identity.
inputs.proposedCopyText: Use your owned Gunblade NY Revision A gunblade.zip with all 18 required payloads.

catalogInput.label: Optional separate Sega billboard firmware
catalogInput.note: Needed only when the required billboard ROM is absent from gunblade.zip.

inputs.evidence: The verified Gunblade set is Revision A gunblade.zip with 18 payloads; a split set may also need segabill.zip.

entries.title: The House of the Dead VR (VR4ALL)

catalogInput.label: Owned original House of the Dead arcade set
catalogInput.note: Original Model 2 revision hotdo with all required payloads. An archive named hotd.zip is accepted only if its contents match the original revision.

inputs.evidence: The original hotdo revision is required with 29 payloads. A legacy hotd.zip name works only for matching original contents, not later Rev A.

catalogInput.label: Owned Behind Enemy Lines arcade set
catalogInput.note: Complete original bel set with all 31 ROM payloads. No separate firmware is required.

inputs.evidence: bel.zip with all 31 original payloads is required; no separate firmware or CHD.

catalogInput.label: Owned Rail Chase 2 arcade set
catalogInput.note: Complete Revision A set, including I/O and billboard firmware if using a combined archive.

inputs.evidence: Revision A rchase2 needs 23 payloads; split media can require segabill.zip. Older 21-file sets are incomplete.

catalogInput.label: Optional separate Sega billboard firmware
catalogInput.note: Needed only when the billboard ROM is absent from rchase2.zip.

inputs.evidence: Revision A rchase2 needs 23 payloads; split media can require segabill.zip. Older 21-file sets are incomplete.

catalogInput.label: Owned Scud Race arcade set
catalogInput.note: Recent MAME 0.289 scud.zip. VR4ALL can package loose files or convert a 7z/RAR archive.

inputs.evidence: The release directs users to put scud.zip on the headset; the current project guide says MAME 0.289-compatible data.

catalogInput.label: Owned Pikmin GameCube disc
catalogInput.note: USA Rev 1 disc image. Quest imports ISO or GCM on first launch; convert RVZ, WIA or GCZ to ISO first. Leave about 2.5 GB free on the headset.

inputs.evidence: The official site currently lists Project Honeydew for Pikmin GameCube USA Rev 1; the Quest install uses the user disc.

catalogInput.label: Owned Ghost Squad Evolution vsg_l folder
catalogInput.note: Choose the complete vsg_l arcade game folder; the author requires its original vsg executable. Do not use the macOS build.

inputs.evidence: The code-only Quest APK requires the complete vsg_l directory, copied to /sdcard/GhostSquadEvolution/vsg_l; its vsg SHA-256 must match the lifted game.

entries.title: The House of the Dead 4 VR

catalogInput.label: Owned House of the Dead 4 game folder
catalogInput.note: Choose the folder containing elf, fs and drv. The author requires the original hod4M.elf revision.

inputs.evidence: The Quest script copies the folder containing elf/hod4M.elf, fs and drv; the executable hash must match the lifted revision.

catalogInput.label: Owned Daytona USA arcade set
catalogInput.note: MAME 0.289 daytona.zip. The app can package loose files or convert a 7z/RAR archive.

inputs.evidence: The creator specifies MAME 0.289 daytona.zip and model1io.zip as two required sets.

catalogInput.label: Model 1 I/O board set
catalogInput.note: MAME 0.289 model1io.zip.

inputs.evidence: The creator specifies MAME 0.289 daytona.zip and model1io.zip as two required sets.

catalogInput.label: Owned Mario Party 4 GameCube disc
catalogInput.note: USA GMPE01 or Europe GMPP01. Choose the disc inside the game on first launch; Japanese editions are unsupported.

inputs.evidence: The current Quest release supports GMPE01 USA rev 0 or 1 and GMPP01 Europe. It accepts ISO, RVZ, WIA and GCZ and checks the disc hash.

catalogInput.label: Owned NTSC-U Crash Team Racing BIN
catalogInput.note: Original PlayStation NTSC-U SCUS-94426 raw BIN. A CUE, CHD or PAL disc is not accepted by the creator’s current build.

inputs.evidence: The Quest guide specifies the owned NTSC-U SCUS-94426 raw BIN at /sdcard/CTR/assets/ctr-u.bin.

catalogInput.label: Owned Victory Heat Rally folder or data.win
catalogInput.hint: Drop the original Steam game folder or its data.win. The creator’s builder verifies the exact supported game revision.

catalogInput.label: Owned US Mystical Ninja N64 ROM
catalogInput.note: US game ROM. Select the copied file from Download in the port’s first-run picker.

inputs.evidence: The author asks for a North American ROM chosen in the start window, but does not list .z64/.n64/.v64 extensions.

catalogInput.label: Owned US Rev 1 WWF No Mercy ROM
catalogInput.note: US Rev 1 / Rev A Nintendo 64 ROM; choose it in the game’s first-run picker.

inputs.evidence: The author requires the North American Rev 1/Rev A game in the main menu, but does not specify extensions.

catalogInput.label: Owned Sin and Punishment N64 ROM
catalogInput.note: Original Japanese ROM or the creator-supported English translation; choose it in the game on first launch.

inputs.evidence: The author supports Japanese original and English fan-translation ROMs; Quest accepts .z64, .n64 and .v64 and imports through its picker.

catalogInput.label: Owned US Rev 1 NFL Blitz 2000 ROM
catalogInput.note: US Rev 1 Nintendo 64 ROM, selected in the game on first launch.

inputs.evidence: The catalog creator URL returned a fetch/cache miss; no primary installation text could be verified.

catalogInput.label: Owned US Bomberman Hero ROM
catalogInput.note: US 1.0 Nintendo 64 ROM; choose it in the game’s first-run picker.

inputs.evidence: The creator requires the North American 1.0 game in its main menu, but does not specify accepted ROM extensions.

catalogInput.label: Owned Arx Fatalis data folder
catalogInput.note: Choose the game folder with data*.pak, sfx.pak, speech*.pak, loc*.pak and its asset folders. Steam, GOG, CD or supported demo data may work.

inputs.evidence: The current v0.3.0 release includes an experimental Quest 3 Android ARM64 APK and directs users to copy data*.pak, sfx.pak, speech*.pak, loc*.pak, misc and graph to /sdcard/ArxLibertatis/. It permits owned Steam, GOG or CD data and the free demo.

catalogInput.label: Owned PAL Wind Waker GameCube ISO
catalogInput.note: Current Quest release requires an uncompressed PAL Europe GZLP01 Rev 0 ISO. Choose it in the port on first launch.

inputs.evidence: The Quest build requires Europe GZLP01 revision 0 as an uncompressed ISO, copied to Download and chosen in the app.

catalogInput.label: Original Daggerfall ARENA2 folder
catalogInput.note: Use the ARENA2 folder from the free original DOS Daggerfall. Choose the folder itself or an archive containing it.

inputs.evidence: The Quest author requires an ARENA2 directory with BSA/SND game files at the app-scoped Daggerfall/arena2 path; the guide does not mention archive selection.

catalogInput.label: Owned Star Fox / Starwing SNES ROM
catalogInput.note: Supported retail Japan, US or Europe revision. The Quest app imports the ROM on first launch; Star Fox 2, hacks and unknown revisions are not supported.

inputs.evidence: The author accepts .sfc/.smc ROMs for listed Japan, USA, Europe and Germany revisions; mobile builds import from a first-run picker.

catalogInput.label: Owned Outlaws Remastered data folder
catalogInput.note: Choose the folder containing olgeo.lab, Common.kpf and UI.kpf from your Steam or GOG Outlaws Remastered install. VR4ALL copies the game archives only.

inputs.evidence: The README confirms olgeo.lab and Outlaws Remastered, but does not substantiate the catalog's Common.kpf and UI.kpf requirements.
inputs.proposedCopyText: Choose the installed Outlaws Remastered folder containing olgeo.lab. Verify the exact archive subset against the creator installer before naming additional files as required.
